# BACTEREMIA ASSOCIATED WITH STREPTOCOCCI

Treatment of S. pyogenes (Group A) and S. agalactiae (Group B)
Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h ($$) [R]
Treatment of S. Pneumoniae or other streptococcal isolates Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M]

# Duration of treatment

Treatment duration is not well established. Treat for 7 -14 days depending on source control and response to treatment. Consult ID for more information.

Therapy:
## Treatment of S. pyogenes (Group A), S. agalactiae (Group B) and S. pneumoniae

Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h ($$) R

## Treatment of other streptococcal isolates with 2 of 2 blood cultures positive or alternative to above

Assessment of beta-lactam reaction
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) M

*Local guidance (Omaha CDSS, Inpatient):*
Bacteremia is typically caused by S. pyogenes (Group A), S. agalactiae (Group B) and S. pneumoniae. Clinical judgement is required for other streptococcal species isolated. Identification and treatment of the source of infection, in addition to antimicrobial therapy, is crucial for resolution of infection.
For patients with toxic shock syndrome refer to those recommendations.
[Toxic Shock Syndrome](toxic-shock-syndrome)
